💖 Story Summary
Meet Nukumizu Kazuhiko, an ordinary high school student who prefers to stay out of the spotlight. One day, he witnesses the popular and energetic Yanami Anna getting rejected by her longtime crush. Soon, he realizes that several other popular girls around him are experiencing the same heartbreak!

As Kazuhiko becomes involved in their lives, he finds himself surrounded by "losing heroines"—girls who aren't destined to win the romance they desire. Filled with comedy, heartfelt moments, friendship, and unexpected emotional depth, this beloved light novel series offers a fresh and entertaining take on the romantic comedy genre.
